description: Third Generation Simulation Data (TGSIM) Foggy Bottom Trajectories is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Federal Highway Administration. (2024). Third Generation Simulation Data (TGSIM) Foggy Bottom Trajectories. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1404230". The main dataset is a 350 MB file of trajectory data (TGSIM-Foggy Bottom-Data.csv) that contains position, speed, and acceleration data for pedestrians, bicycles, scooters, non-automated passenger cars, automated vehicles, motorcycles, buses, and trucks in an urban environment. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 12 columns, among them yloc_kf, speed_kf_x, lane_kf, type_most_common, width_smoothed, length_smoothed. The portal shows 2024-11-04 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation:. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
